card.name: Antibiotic resistance warning phrasing
card.fires_on: The word "of" in "in the absence of a proven or strongly suspected bacterial infection", and "that" before "are proven or strongly suspected", in antibacterial warning sections. It also fires occasionally inside names split into pieces.
